title: Mitigating Covariate Shift in Behavioral Cloning via Robust Stationary Distribution Correction
title_zh: 通过稳健的平稳分布校正缓解行为克隆中的协变量偏移

paragraphs.en: DrilDICE通过平稳分布校正缓解行为克隆的协变量偏移，提升离线模仿学习稳健性。 We consider offline imitation learning (IL), which aims to train an agent to imitate from the dataset of expert demonstrations without online interaction with the environment. Behavioral Cloning (BC) has been a simple yet effective approach to offline IL, but it is also well-known to be vulnerable to the covariate shift resulting from the mismatch between the state distributions induced by the learned policy and the expert policy. Moreover, as often occurs in practice, when expert datasets are collected from an arbitrary state distribution instead of a stationary one, these shifts become more pronounced, potentially leading to substantial failures in existing IL methods. Specifically, we focus on covariate shift resulting from arbitrary state data distributions, such as biased data collection or incomplete trajectories, rather than shifts induced by changes in dynamics or noisy expert actions. In this paper, to mitigate the effect of the covariate shifts in BC, we propose DrilDICE, which utilizes a distributionally robust BC objective by employing a stationary distribution correction ratio estimation (DICE) to derive a feasible solution. We evaluate the effectiveness of our method through an extensive set of experiments covering diverse covariate shift scenarios. The results demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed approach in improving the robustness against the shifts, outperforming existing offline IL methods in such scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: DrilDICE通过平稳分布校正缓解行为克隆的协变量偏移，提升离线模仿学习稳健性。我们考虑离线模仿学习（IL），其目标是训练一个智能体从专家演示数据集中进行模仿，而无需与环境进行在线交互。 行为克隆（BC）是一种简单而有效的离线IL方法，但众所周知，它容易受到协变量偏移的影响，这种偏移源于学习到的策略所诱导的状态分布与专家策略所诱导的状态分布之间的不匹配。 此外，正如实践中经常出现的情况，当专家数据集是从任意状态分布而非平稳分布中收集时，这些偏移会变得更加显著，可能导致现有IL方法出现严重失败。 具体而言，我们关注由任意状态数据分布（例如有偏的数据收集或不完整的轨迹）引起的协变量偏移，而非由动力学变化或有噪声的专家动作引起的偏移。 在本文中，为了缓解BC中协变量偏移的影响，我们提出了DrilDICE，它通过采用平稳分布校正比率估计（DICE）来构建分布鲁棒的BC目标，从而推导出可行的解决方案。 我们通过涵盖多种协变量偏移场景的大量实验来评估我们方法的有效性。 结果表明，所提出的方法在提升针对这些偏移的鲁棒性方面是有效的，在此类场景中优于现有的离线IL方法。
